tagline_zh: 粽香飘四方，龙舟竞中流
tagline_en: Where Ancient Tradition Meets Your Table
intro_zh: 端午节是中国最古老的传统节日之一，已有两千余年历史。相传为纪念爱国诗人屈原投江而设。每逢端午，人们赛龙舟、裹粽子、挂艾草，以驱邪避害、寄托思念。如今，端午节已成为连接全球华人的文化纽带，也是向邻里朋友介绍中华文化的最佳时机。
intro_en: Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu Jié) has been celebrated for over 2,000 years across China and Chinese communities worldwide. Legend honors the patriot-poet Qu Yuan. Today the festival is marked by thrilling dragon boat races, handmade zongzi (sticky rice dumplings), and aromatic mugwort hung at the door — a perfect moment to share Chinese culture with your neighbors and friends.
